parameters.content:
## Himalayas Remote Job Finder with Salary & Tech Stack

**Actor:** [Himalayas Remote Job Finder with Salary & Tech Stack](https://apify.com/vexaloom-labs/himalayas-remote-job-finder-with-salary-and-tech)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/himalayas-remote-job-finder-with-salary-and-tech-stack.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `searchQuery` (string)
- `companySlug` (string)
- `jobUrls` (array)
- `country` (string)
- `worldwide` (boolean)
- `excludeWorldwide` (boolean)
- `seniority` (array)
- `employmentType` (string)
- `timezone` (string)
- `categories` (array)
- `minSalary` (integer)

### Output fields
- `title` (Title)
- `company` (Company)
- `employmentType` (Employment Type)
- `seniority` (Seniority)
- `salaryMin` (Salary Min)
- `salaryMax` (Salary Max)
- `salaryPeriod` (Salary Period)
- `salaryCurrency` (Salary Currency)
- `salaryAnnualMin` (Salary Annual Min)
- `salaryAnnualMax` (Salary Annual Max)
- `location` (Location)
- `skills` (Skills)

description: Himalayas remote job: runs the Himalayas Remote Job Finder with Salary & Tech Stack Apify Actor, returns title, company, salaryMin, salaryMax, salaryPeriod and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
